rationale: Per-dimension whitening was rejected: it would inflate the lowest-variance dims (min per-dim variance observed here) to the same scale as 'massive activation' outlier dims (max per-dim variance observed here), destroying the magnitude structure a dictionary is supposed to discover. A single global scalar scale (after centering) preserves relative direction/magnitude structure while putting ||x|| on a scale where a chosen sparsity coefficient and reconstruction loss are numerically comparable across widths.
